correction: Cloudflare cron triggers count the days of the week from 1 = Sunday to 7 = Saturday: Monday is 2 (or MON), not 1. A weekly cron day must be checked with that numbering.
evidence: frostyard/problem-intake#30: GET /v1/stats on Monday 2026-11-16 listed 2026-W45 as the newest week, because "23 3 * * 1" ran the job on Sunday
